topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Mornin', friend. I reckon the skies must've had their own plans, much like the time the rains delayed our plowin'. We lost more than a day, but when that storm did clear, the earth was rich and ready. Ain’t much we can do but wait and trust the saints. They look after us, in their own good time, just as they’ll look after you. The important folks ‘ll understand, seein' as how even the wind and the clouds can delay a man’s doin’s. Hold your head up, and when the time comes, show ‘em what you’re made of. It’s a test, sure, but somethin' tells me you’re well-prepared for it. Godspeed, and may the saints keep you.
